title: Forms gallery — two locks
question: Google Forms / Docs is the craft bar. Pick the preview depth and primary click for the v2 gallery.

options.label: Live scaled form → Edit
options.thesis: Each card shows a miniature of the real questions; hover lifts and subtly pans the preview; click opens the editor.
options.viewport: Grid of paper-like cards: large preview pane, title + opened/updated footer, Edit/Preview on hover.
options.risk: Heavy forms may cost layout work; keep preview non-interactive and capped.

options.label: Live scaled form → Preview
options.thesis: Same miniature document cards, but the primary click opens responder preview; Edit stays a secondary action.
options.viewport: Same gallery grid; footer actions emphasize Preview first.
options.risk: Organisers usually want to edit—extra hop if Preview is primary.

options.label: Stylized mock → Edit
options.thesis: Cards use a lightweight document mock (title + question lines) instead of rendering real section components; click opens editor.
options.viewport: Same Docs-like grid, faster and more uniform previews, less fidelity to the real form.
options.risk: Loses the ‘this is my form’ recognition that live previews give.
